standard_prerequisites.name: The factorization of the diagonal through the graph of the morphism and the base change of the diagonal by the source
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 2923-2933)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies surjectivity of the diagonal with surjectivity of its pullback along the identity section.

standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion that a morphism of algebraic spaces is surjective if and only if it is surjective on points after base change to fields
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2934-2939) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces surjectivity of the diagonal to a condition on points over fields.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the points of a fibre product of stacks over a field as pairs of points isomorphic after base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 2940-2960)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the pointwise condition into the statement that two points of the source with the same image are equal, which is universal injectivity.

core_obligations: Reformulate the diagonal: the diagonal factors as the base change of the diagonal by the identity section, so surjectivity of the diagonal is equivalent to surjectivity of the induced morphism over the source (proof lines 2923-2933)
Pointwise criterion: apply the field-valued criterion for surjectivity of a morphism of algebraic spaces (proof lines 2934-2939)

Read off the condition: over a field, a point of the fibre product is a pair of points of the source mapping to the same point of the target and isomorphic after the base change, and surjectivity says precisely that any such pair already comes from a single point, which is the definition of universal injectivity (proof lines 2940-2972)
proof_roadmap: 把 Δ_f 看作 X 上的态射（单位截面的基变换），满性等价于 X ×_Y X 上那支的满性。
用「代数空间态射满 ⟺ 对任意域上点满」的判据。
域上把 X ×_Y X 的点理解为「同一像点的两个点」，满性正是「像同 ⇒ 点同」＝一致单射。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks is universally injective if and only if its diagonal is surjective (author lemma at source lines 2906-2920, label lemma-universally-injective). The proof (source lines 2922-2974) rewrites the diagonal as the base change of itself along the identity section, applies the field-valued criterion for surjectivity of morphisms of algebraic spaces, and translates the resulting pointwise condition into the equality of points with common image, which is universal injectivity (proof lines 2923-2972). The reformulation of the diagonal and the translation of surjectivity into the defining condition on points are the content. H3.
